actions.text: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent.

official_title: A resolution honoring the life and legacy of Fiona the hippopotamus of the Cincinnati Zoo and Botanical Garden, and expressing the gratitude of the Senate to the staff of the Cincinnati Zoo for their extraordinary care and dedication.
